title: Pomodoro method
text: Work for 25 minutes then rest for 5. After four rounds take a longer break of 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Spaced repetition
text: Review a topic after 1 day then 3 days then 7 days then 21 days so that it moves into long-term memory.

title: Active recall
text: Close the book and write down everything you remember before checking. It is slower than re-reading but works better.

title: Exam week plan
text: Do the hardest subject in the morning. Keep the last evening before an exam for light revision and sleep.
